parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The metering method of QPS. Valid values:

*   **month**: monthly 95th percentile QPS.
*   **day**: daily 95th percentile QPS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-qps-mode --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-7e225i410000 --biz-mode month --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
